title: Choose the visual world for the AgniDrishti dashboard
question: The roll assigned Burans & Slate. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Burans & Slate
options.lineage: Garhwal and Kumaon hill materials in fire season
options.thesis: Each alert wears the colour of what burns: burans red to send, chir-pine ochre to check, slate to log.
options.viewport: Deodar-green rail with live counts; ranked queue with reasons inline; terrain map; the selected alert's evidence and lifecycle below.
options.risk: Reads as a regional theme instead of a tool if the palette is applied timidly or as decoration.

raised.raise: Panels persist: picking an alert swaps the detail panel's contents, never the layout.
Each alert's life (injected, VERIFY, smoke, DISPATCH, sent) is a strip whose segment lengths are real seconds.
Every neutral comes from one 11-step slate ramp; no stray greys.
J and K step through the queue with the next alert's detail already loaded.
Tier colour is flat and unmodulated everywhere: no gradients, no glow.

options.label: Toposheet
options.thesis: Alerts plotted the way foresters read the land: contours, compartments, grid references.
options.viewport: A toposheet-styled terrain map leads; the ranked queue sits in the sheet's margin like its legend.
options.risk: Familiar: map-led ops dashboards are where most runs land, and it pulls toward map-first, which you ruled out.

options.label: Gate board
options.lineage: airport gate boards and Indian Railways departure boards
options.thesis: The alert queue as a live departure board: rows re-rank in place and changes stay lit.
options.viewport: A full-width ranked board by tier, then p; a selected row opens a segmented pass with its reasons.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: the ranking is the product and the live re-rank is the demo moment; loses on audience, since a gate board isn't the forest office.
options.risk: Reads as transport signage, and board density can bury the reasons.

options.label: Graphite console
options.thesis: A dark, panel-tiled work surface divided by hairline seams.
options.viewport: Persistent panels: queue, map, detail, log.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a coder's console isn't a forest office, and it's no clearer.
options.kept: Panels persist; selecting changes contents, not the layout.
options.risk: Reads as developer tooling and drifts toward the glowing control-room look.

options.label: Dance score
options.thesis: Time runs up a central staff, and length is exact duration.
options.viewport: Alerts as blocks on a vertical time staff, with columns by tier.
options.case: Fuses poorly: officers don't read scores, and clarity drops.
options.kept: A lifecycle strip with segment lengths in real seconds.

options.label: Exposure record
options.thesis: A neutral zone ramp where hatch density is load and crossing hatches flag conflict.
options.viewport: Stacked sheets for queue, map and detail, with conflicting signals cross-hatched.
options.case: Fuses poorly: darkroom notation is foreign to foresters.
options.kept: All neutrals from one 11-step slate ramp.
options.risk: Hatching adds noise to a dense table.

options.label: One alert per screen
options.thesis: One alert fills the screen, and the next is one flick away.
options.viewport: A single alert full screen, reasons low, actions on a right rail.
options.case: Fuses poorly: it hides the ranked queue, which you ruled out.
options.kept: Keyboard stepping with the next alert preloaded.

options.label: Guide map
options.thesis: Areas as flat colour lobes, with capsules marking what's live.
options.viewport: The division drawn as swelling lobes, with alert capsules on the coastline.
options.case: Fuses poorly: playful flatness undercuts emergency triage.
options.kept: Flat, unmodulated tier colour; no gradients or glow.
options.risk: Reads as leisure, not fire work.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: An operations dashboard done right: neutral shell, count strip, map and table side by side.
canonCard.viewport: Top bar with counts; map on the left, sortable table on the right, a detail drawer.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any GIS operations dashboard, by design.
